description.narrative: The Project Development Objective is to prevent, detect and respond to the threat posed by COVID-19 andstrengthen the national health system for public health preparedness.

The project aims to support the MOH immediately respond and mitigate risks associated with the COVID-19 outbreak in Jordan. Based on the COVID-19 National Response Plan, the project aims to fill critical gaps in the following technical areas: country-level coordination planning and monitoring; risk communication and community engagement; surveillance, rapid response teams and case investigation; point of entry; national laboratories; infection prevention and control; case management; and operation support and logistics.

condition.narrative: Schedule 2, Section I, A, 1: Borrower shall maintain, throughout Project implementation, an International Coordination and ProjectManagement Unit within the MOH in charge of overall coordination of the Project.

Schedule 2, Section I, A, 1: The Borrower, through MOH, shall staff ICPMU, including hiring of: (i) financial officer andprocurement specialist, not later than ninety (90) days; and (ii) environmental and social safeguard consultants, no later than onehundred and twenty (120) days after the Effective Date.
Schedule 2, Section I, B, 1: Not later than ninety (90) days after the Effective Date, the Borrower shall, through MOH, adopt thePOM, satisfactory to the Bank.
Schedule 2, Section I, C, 1: The Borrower, through the ICPMU, shall prepare and furnish to the Bank, not later than January 31 ofeach year, starting January 1, 2021, an Annual Work Plan and Budget.
Schedule 2, Section I, C, 4: The Borrower, through the MOH, shall appoint a verification agency to carry out, under termssatisfactory to the Bank, a technical audit of the Project implementation.
Schedule 2, Section I, D, 7: The Borrower, not later than seventy five (75) days after the Effective Date, shall furnish to theBank the ESMF and LMP in a manner acceptable to the Bank.
Schedule 2, Section I, E, 1 (a): The Borrower shall prepare and furnish to the Bank for its review and approval, a ContingentEmergency Response Component Manual (CERCM).
